evals.name: build-english-game-from-youtube
evals.prompt: Make this a card0 game: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MNb8pGvKn6w&t=295s. This is a 2-player desert-themed drafting game called Desperate Oasis. Use the English rules exactly as shown in the video.
evals.expected_output: A published English card0 game (gameId returned) with: cover image uploaded, ~15 oasis cards uploaded (3 rounds × 5 cards), ~14 animal cards uploaded across 7 unique species with quantity 1-3 each. Manifest passes `card0 game validate`. The artwork shows each card's name and value rendered on the image in English.

evals.name: localize-existing-game-to-zh-Hans
evals.prompt: 再做一個中文版的 Desperate Oasis: game id b3abeac2-0404-49ba-b09b-5776b82eeb62. Translate all card names and ability text into Simplified Chinese, regenerate the cover and every card image with the Chinese text rendered on the artwork, and publish the new game as a separate zh-Hans game.
evals.expected_output: A new Chinese (zh-Hans) card0 game created from a translated manifest. The cover, oasis cards, and animal cards all have the Chinese name and ability text correctly rendered on the image. Manifest.language is "zh-Hans" (not "zh"). All 22 cards have uploaded images. gameId and a summary of the 22 uploads is returned.

evals.name: localize-existing-game-to-ja
evals.prompt: 日本語版も作って: game id 3c5ab16a-cd2d-4ba2-851b-c44d6bd11ee9. Translate everything into Japanese and regenerate the artwork with the Japanese text on the image. Publish as a separate Japanese game.
evals.expected_output: A new Japanese (ja) card0 game with localized cover and all 22 cards. Manifest.language is "ja". Each card's Japanese name and ability text is rendered on the image with no garbled characters. All 22 cards uploaded. Summary includes gameId and any image imperfections noted (e.g. a particular kanji that didn't render cleanly).

evals.name: build-all-three-languages-at-once
evals.prompt: Make this a card0 game in English, Simplified Chinese, and Japanese all at once: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MNb8pGvKn6w. One game per language, each with its own localized artwork.
evals.expected_output: Three separate card0 games created in one pass: one en, one zh-Hans, one ja. All three manifests are authored together with identical value/quantity/type fields. All three games get their own cover and card artwork with the respective language's text rendered on the image. Game IDs for all three are reported. Art generation may run in parallel but uploads are sequential per language.

evals.name: troubleshoot-image-too-large
evals.prompt: card0 card image upload is failing with IMAGE_TOO_LARGE for my game. The PNGs from Seedream are around 6MB each. What do I do?
evals.expected_output: A correct diagnosis (image > 5 MB) and a working JPEG-compression script (PIL, quality=85, max 1500px long side) that the user can run. The skill should also flag that the same script lives at references/image-pipeline.md so the user knows where the canonical version is.
